name: jira-flow
description: Adds a single atlassian-expert worker plus Jira-aware slash commands (configure, capture, plan-track-build-validate, execute, fix, drain, advance) on top of any topology that ships planning-lead, engineering-lead, and validation-lead subagents — or any topology with a custom lifecycle declared in jira-flow.yaml (project root, used by /advance). /execute auto-routes Bug cards to /fix (reproduce-fix-verify); use --force-feature-flow to override. Run /jira-flow:configure once after install to set site/project/board. Tested with hex-backend, multi-team, and discovery. Won't work with solo-pair for the lead-based commands.
